hints.title: Separating Linear Terms and Constants
hints.text: Split the expression by the equality symbol, parsing each side into total variable coefficient and total constant value.

hints.title: Parsing Signs and Implicit Coefficients
hints.text: Scan each side character by character, tracking the current sign. Handle tokens ending with the variable symbol, noting that an isolated symbol implies coefficient one.

hints.title: Simplifying to Canonical Linear Form
hints.text: Let left yield c1 * x + k1 and right yield c2 * x + k2. Subtract to form (c1 - c2) * x = k2 - k1. If coefficient is zero, check if constant is zero for infinite solutions versus no solution; otherwise divide.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of the equation string
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full syntax tree parsers are unnecessarily complex for simple linear expressions with only additions and subtractions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Token-based single-pass parsing avoids storing abstract syntax trees.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle signs correctly, account for implicit unit coefficients like x or -x, and cover singular cases.
